rationale: Papers 2506.21753 and 2507.16365 investigate the energy distribution of FRBs and their potential connection to magnetars, providing evidence on the brightness distribution and origins. Paper 2310.16932 reports on FRB-like bursts from SGR 1935+2154, contributing to understanding the brightness comparison with Galactic magnetars. These studies provide substantive evidence but do not fully settle the question.
